title: The Loop That Steals
goal: Print every word, then the count - one edit, no clones.
hints: `for w in words` calls into_iter() - the whole Vec moves into the loop.
Loop over a borrow instead, and the Vec is still yours afterwards.
explanation: A for loop consumes what you give it: `for w in words` moves the Vec (into_iter), so words.len() afterwards is use-after-move. Cloning the whole Vec buys the loop its own copy - legal, wasteful. `for w in &words` iterates borrowed elements and the Vec survives untouched: one edit, zero allocations. The loop variable also changes meaning (String vs &String) - the printing works either way.
